scope: Source/material and typography fidelity only; no mathematical refereeing
review_method: Fresh r004 cover manually inspected with precise literal source-wording disclosures for native 1829/1831 and 1875, compared against original pages 41–42. All 45 author-body pages are exact pixel matches to r003 with both PDFs and page mapping pinned. In r003, all 46 fresh output pages manually inspected on eight compact contact sheets. The complete selected Theorem 1.9, strong-connectivity path construction, run-size/factorial bounds, stars-and-bars tail bounds, Stirling analysis and Mann–Whitney coarsening were compared at original pages 7, 32 and 40–43 against output pages 5, 24 and 31–33. The complete required source-local characteristic-function, Gaussian center bound, three-region peripheral bound, pole reduction and interval matching core was compared at original pages 44–55 against output pages 33–42. The two approved orphan text semicolon removals preserve the complete Figure 10a and its surroundings at original page 35/output page 26. All 18 figures are complete; 17 remain editable native TikZ and the original permutahedron PDF matches original page 9/output page 7. All 29 exact native bibliography entries were compared at original pages 59–61/output pages 44–46. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or unresolved references.

source_alias_numbering_comparison.support_labels: Strong Connectivity Lemma 7.1, original Propositions 8.3/8.8/8.9 and complete local Lemmas/Claims 9.3–9.22 retain source numbering and are not separate units.
source_alias_numbering_comparison.equations: All original 8.6–8.13 and 9.1–9.4 displays, exact characteristic-function phases, Fourier integrals, three-region bounds and pole-matching inequalities compared. Native Pi-T/Pi-XInv notation discrepancy remains visibly documented.
source_alias_numbering_comparison.bibliography: All 29 exact native entries and source order, names, accents, DOI links and original figure attribution preserved; publisher automatic backreferences omitted.
source_alias_numbering_comparison.notation: Original Greek parameters, floors/ceilings, factorial products, set and permutation notation, all TikZ mathematical labels and diagram path punctuation unchanged.

bounded_context_typography: Exactly two orphan text semicolons following the original Figure 10a spacing definitions are removed for rendering under the documented review; raw originals and failed nullfont build retained, no mathematical token changes.
